project_type: Full-stack educational AI platform: Cloudflare Edge Worker (TS) + FastAPI backend (Python) + Vite React SPA
build_system: Edge: wrangler (CF Workers), Backend: pip-compile, Frontend: Vite + custom build pipeline (scripts/build.mjs)
test_framework: Edge: vitest, Backend: pytest (anyio), Frontend: vitest + testing-library
build_command: Edge: cd apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit; Backend: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest (no explicit build); Frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm run build
test_command: Edge: cd apps/edge && npx vitest run; Backend: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/; Frontend: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit in apps/edge to validate TypeScript. 2. Run vitest in apps/edge for edge tests. 3. Run pytest in apps/backend for backend tests.
setup_instructions: Edge: cd apps/edge && npm install; Backend: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt; Frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11, Node 22 available. No Docker daemon needed. Edge uses Cloudflare Worker APIs (caches.default, KV, R2). Backend requires MongoDB/Redis (mocked in tests).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Edge worker uses modular middleware pattern. Backend uses service classes with static methods. Tests mock external services.
key_patterns: Edge: single fetch handler with middleware pipeline (CORS > JWT > Bot > Rate Limit > Routing). Backend: ChatService is a static-method class. Frontend: already uses /chat/stream SSE for all chat. Critical CSS already inline via Beasties. Early Hints preload headers already configured via vite-plugins/preload-headers-inject.js.
directory_structure: apps/edge/src/ - CF Worker entry + middleware + routes; apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app with services/models/api; apps/frontend/src/ - Vite React SPA with pages/components/hooks
